title: Hot Spicy Malaysian Chicken Satay
description: A fresh and springy Malaysian dish featuring chicken satay, served on a hot stone plate, perfect for a solo dinner, with a unique tempering chocolate twist, this low sodium friendly dish is a must try, the peppercorns add a nice spicy kick
instructions: Preheat a hot stone plate to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender, combine coconut milk, garlic, ginger, and cayenne pepper, and blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, whisk together the blended mixture and chicken breast strips, and let marinate for 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated chicken strips onto skewers.
Brush the hot stone plate with vegetable oil.
Place the skewers on the hot stone plate and cook for 5 minutes per side.
Melt the dark chocolate in a double boiler.
Temper the chocolate by cooling it to 82 degrees Fahrenheit.
Serve the chicken satay on the hot stone plate, garnished with peppercorns and a drizzle of tempered chocolate.
